# netbox_vlan_translation_rule (Data Source)

Retrieves a single vlan translation rule from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vlan_translation_rule" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "vlan_translation_rule_id" {
  value = data.netbox_vlan_translation_rule.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the vlan translation rule.
- `local_vid` (Number) The local vid of the vlan translation rule.
- `policy` (Number) The policy of the vlan translation rule.
- `remote_vid` (Number) The remote vid of the vlan translation rule.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The created of the vlan translation rule.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the vlan translation rule, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the vlan translation rule.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the vlan translation rule.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
